structuredContent.body:
C258 needs to distinguish explicit following from lifecycle ownership when checking localized edits. This PR integrates the already-reviewed finite follow observer and its retained evidence.

## Changes

- Derive explicit follow parent frames, children and constant offsets from authoritative `.ok` declarations.
- Inspect actual GLB follow claims independently and compare them with source-derived facts through separate API boundaries.
- Preserve all original failed attempts, corrected scientific/structural reviews and source/evidence hashes.
- Update five current navigation/status documents without modifying shared runtime, parser, Agent, exporter or hosted workflows.

This continues the existing C258 branch and scope #245. It introduces no hinge implementation or successor feature.

## Exact candidate and ownership

Published head: `233711ea107dc04a60fadcc05174bb834ced40eb`, tree `ca849419b448a50255fff76da26f51920e7af990`. Its tree equals independently approved local continuation `80372672906021f2ccbeea95f62a018903d1f837`. Its parents retain published C258 `039b6f425afc590d609511d936c88d5b43564035` and acquired main lease `3eaf74ce3b6965e682163979c077a4f5bf164b2c`.

The only change from the prior approved content tree is the STATUS ownership section. Owner `c258-root-78ebb05e03a4-20261117` holds the verified conditional main lease until 2026-11-17T18:30:52Z. Prior ownership, refs, open PRs, all 14 accessible product worktrees and pending outcomes were reconciled before takeover.

## Validation and remaining gates

- Independent retention/evidence review passes 646 bindings, including 136 component payloads, 170 evidence mappings and 11 input pins.
- Historical identified scientific evidence remains eligible by exact input equality: 28 authored C258 methods and 119 independent controls; separate structural review remains distinct. These tests were not rerun on the continuation candidate.
- Historical focused dependency results retain C257 23 methods, C256 29 methods, C255 31 methods and the C253 14-file/three-case manifest.
- Fresh documentation check on local candidate `803726...` passes 29 sources, 233 sections and 5,519 local links, with clean unchanged source.
- Independent continuation review approves the exact tree and STATUS-only reconciliation.

After the guarded merge, execute fresh C258/C257/C256/C255, C253 manifest and documentation checks on actual main. Then preserve receipts, release the lease, verify branch retirement, restore and save the standalone handoff before closing #245. Hosted CI has no fresh result; it remains manual-only under OK-ENG-006.

## Boundaries

This is finite development integration. Hinges, complete semantic/revision/rebuild qualification, world-motion agreement, native/model trials and comparative advantage remain unqualified. Strict normal-fidelity failure, R07/R08 and C251 authority limitations retain their status. C234 is already merged and awaits user cleanup; retain C174 historical archive.

Recovery source: [verified input ZIP](https://chatgpt.com/library?file_id=libfile_fde3_f-8a1faacc7ee08191be12ac85971622b4_2ab2a24d43748191957f9bcc356b59de&account_id=personal). [Continuation checkpoint](https://chatgpt.com/library?file_id=libfile_fde3_f-8aee875737988191a6e2513216afdda4_2ab2a24d43748191957f9bcc356b59de&account_id=personal) and [progress recovery ZIP](https://chatgpt.com/library?file_id=libfile_fde3_f-deab7a385bd88191898ed9804870e56f_2ab2a24d43748191957f9bcc356b59de&account_id=personal).
